newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee ends off highs after NY rally.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee ends off highs after NY rally.

text.p: LIFFE coffee futures reversed an earlier weaker trend to end Friday higher but well below the day's peaks on late selling.
Traders said London advanced in mid-afternoon after New York rose sharply on speculative buying.

Robustas gave back some of their gains but still closed higher. September, which earlier in the week dipped to a low of $1,530 a tonne, regained the $1,600 mark to touch a high of $1,625 and pave the way for further progress next week.
"Technically, it's quite a positive finish at $1,600," said one trader.
However dealings were thin with just 2,929 lots changing hands.
Sept/Dec spread stood at level money at the close against $10 on Thursday.
Robustas saw some losses towards the close on Thursday on light stop-loss selling although volume was far from impressive.
Earlier, some technical analysts said the coffee market risked further retracement towards the immediate $1,530 support as it builds a new, lower trading range.
On the upside, strong resistance was at $1,700, then up to $1,750.
On the weather front, Brazil's coffee areas are heading into a frost-free weekend again. The outlook is for mild weather from Sunday through Tuesday, weathermen say.
